This viral sport, known as Hobby Duro, has competitors sprinting, jumping, and tackling extreme Enduro-style obstacles while pretending they’re riding dirt bikes. It looks ridiculous at first… but by the end, you’ll understand why millions of people can’t stop watching.

How many jumps did you count? Let us know in the comments! 👇
